core_memory.customer_profile: Name: Michael. Age: 35. Seattle. Freelance graphic designer, works from home. Values design-forward gadgets that fit his lifestyle. First-time customer. Interested in high-quality coffee machines(drip + espresso) to upgrade morning routine.
core_memory.design_preference: Prefers sleek, modern, stainless-steel finish on appliances. Design buff—look/feel matters a lot. Wants grinder that pairs aesthetically(stainless/modern) with the espresso machine. Interested in coffee beans + small grinder(fresh-grind purist friend) if not too pricey.
core_memory.promo_interest: Wants New Customer Discount(~17% off) applied at checkout; anxious about coupon field, needs exact code + how to apply. Also interested in bundle deals/limited-time promos. Payment: usually credit card; curious about PayPal, Apple Pay, and no-interest-6-month financing for pricier items.
core_memory.shipping_needs: Seattle. Rainy-weather concerns(past soggy boxes). Wants warehouse origin, processing + shipping ETA. Needs machine for small family event end of month. Open to expedited(will pay small fee). Wants free-shipping threshold. Considering accessories. Wants real-time tracking to be home/avoid rain.
core_memory.referral_and_priorities: Referred by friend(air fryer/blender, praised support). Big coffee lover. DECIDED: espresso machine with steam wand for milk frothing(matcha lattes, cappuccinos, hosting). Brew temp make-or-break: wants adjustable temp/reliably hot. Cares about capacity & cleaning.
core_memory.counter_space: Total counter space: 38 sq ft. Counter crowded with appliances; willing to relocate toaster oven to another counter and reorganize spice rack to fit the espresso machine. Wants exact machine dimensions before buying to plan footprint.
core_memory.warranty_concern: Wants warranty/quality guarantee confirmed. Past bad experiences: short warranties, difficult service. Wants return/exchange policy clarity: who pays return shipping for defects vs. change-of-mind(wrong size). Cautious due to past return nightmares.
